card.name: Borg Queen, The One Who Is Many

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Title Trait] STARTING PLOT POINTS 0
[Title Trait] CONTINUITY When Borg Queen, The One Who Is Many is KO'd, opposing characters can use Outwit on their next turn.
[Plus Plot Points] ISN'T THIS EASIER? FREE: Choose one: MOVE -or- CLOSE -or- RANGE. Actions of the chocen type given to friendly characters that are adjacent or have the Borg keyword don't count against your action total this turn.
[Minus Plot Points] TRANSPORTER FREE: Choose a character on your sideline with the Borg keyword and a starting line for that character. You may pay 1PP plus 1PP per 10 full points of the character's cost to place that character on the starting line in an unossupied square within 6 squares and line of fire. A force may only have one character placed by this effect on the map at a time. (Example: You would pay 5PP for a 40-49 point character.)
[Minus Plot Points] ASSIMILATION FREE: Choose a character from your opponent's KO area. You may pay 1 PP plus 1 PP per 10 full points of that character's starting line played this game to place that character on that starting line in an unoccupied square within 6 squares and line of fire. That character becomes friendly to your force. A force may have only one character placed by this effect on the map at a time. (Example: You would remove 5 Plot Points for a 40-49 point character.)

[Trait] SHIFTING FOCUS: DATA FREE: If Lt. Commander Data began your turn on the map, replace him with another character with this trait on the same click number.
[Trait] OUR ADVERSARY IS NONE OTHER THAN PROFESSOR MORIARTY HIMSELF When an opposing character within 6 squares would use Outwit, Perplex, or Probability Control, you and that opponent each roll 2d6, and you add Lt. Commander Data's Deduction tokens. If your result is higher, instead that opposing character can't use that power this turn and Lt. Commander Data gets a Deduction token.

[Damage] ELEMENTARY, MY DEAR GEORDI Powers: Probability Control Probability Control. When Lt. Commander Data uses it, the result can't be further rerolled.

[Trait] OPPORTUNISTIC MANEUVER FREE: Once per turn, for all characters that can use this trait, choose a friendly character that took 2 or more damage from a single attack since your last turn. You may place Mirror Beverly Crusher within 6 squares and line of fire of the opposing character that made that attack. You may then replace Mirror Beverly Crusher with another character that can use the Opportunistic Maneuver trait from your sideline (on thesame click number).
[Trait] ADVANCING THROUGH THE RANKS When this character is placed by a character's use of the Opportunistic Maneuvers trait, until your next turn, this character has "Opposing characters within 6 squares can't use Willpower or be healed."
[Trait] MIRROR, MIRROR Powers: Shape Change Shape Change. When Mirror Beverly Crusher uses Shape Change and succeeds, give her a Mirror token, and if she fails, remove all Mirror tokens. When she uses Shape Change, increase the result by +1 for each Mirror token (a roll of [d:1] always fails).
[Damage] USE MY SON'S GENIUS TO ADVANCE MY CAREER Powers: Outwit, Perplex, Probability Control, Support Outwit, Perplex, Probability Control, Support
